about.title: About
about.hiTtsIntro: Hi-TTS aims to make Text-to-Speech simple, reliable and pleasant to use by linking your Twitch rewards to ElevenLabs voices, while staying transparent about how your data is handled.
about.hiarteBodyMain: Hi-TTS is built and maintained by Hiarte, an independent studio creating tools and experiences for content creators and streamers.
about.hiarteBodyMore: If you want to discover other available apps, see ongoing projects or learn more about the company, you can find all the information on Hiarte's website.
about.privacyIntro: The application only uses the information that is strictly necessary to work with Twitch and ElevenLabs services.
about.privacyTwitch:
1. Data related to Twitch
In the desktop app, your OAuth token is stored outside the web page, encrypted with the OS-backed secure storage, and only decrypted in the main process. It is not kept in plain text in the page's localStorage.

A fully compromised machine or malicious software is still a risk: be careful with what you install.
about.privacyEleven:
2. Data related to ElevenLabs
Your API key is handled like the Twitch token: encrypted app-side on desktop when the OS supports it, and only used to call the ElevenLabs API.

The key is sensitive: never share it. Anyone with privileged access to your machine could still extract it from memory or backups.
about.privacyTransmission:
3. Data transmission
The application does not send data to any unexpected third-party server. The only external communications performed are those required to work with the official APIs of Twitch and ElevenLabs.
about.privacyStorage:
4. Local storage
The connection and configuration information mentioned above is kept locally on your machine. It is not centralised on a server managed by the application itself.
about.footerTagline: Free TTS tool for Twitch • © 2026 Hiarte

twitchLogin.tokenNote: Hi-TTS is a free app by Hiarte. Your Twitch token is stored locally (encrypted by the OS when possible) for your personal use only and is only sent to Twitch. Never share it.
